_comment: plan-rag-context P2: the document-tree order, as data. The backend (kb/tree_order.py) walks neighbours in this order and the frontend file tree (web/src/pages/investigation/fileTree.ts) displays it; BOTH test suites assert every case here, so a change on one side reddens the other. Rule: at each path level directories sort before files; among siblings, maximal ASCII-digit runs compare by numeric value, everything else by Unicode code point after case-folding, with the raw string as the final tiebreak. Locale-independent by construction.

cases.name: digit runs compare by value, so 9 precedes 10
equal values tie-break on the raw string (code point)
case-insensitive, raw string breaks the tie
a directory sorts before a file at the same level, whatever the names
nested: directories first inside a folder too, then files naturally
CJK numerals are NOT numeric: code-point order (一 < 三 < 二)
full-width digits are NOT numeric either: only ASCII 0-9 count
a digit run sorts before a text run at the same position
the slide-screenshot case the user rule is written for
user rule: prefix with Arabic numerals to force an order
